info.name: FANA · Al Tilal Lead Webhook
info.description: Test the n8n Lead Webhook. Set webhook_url to the PRODUCTION URL of the "Lead Webhook" node (workflow must be Published). Every request returns {reply, lead_id, duplicate, normalized, saved_this_turn}. Synthetic data only.

exec: // one run id per Postman session → fresh chats and fresh event ids

item.name: 1 · Normalization (كل مصدر بشكله الحقيقي)
item.description: Each request is a different source with different field names. Check the "normalized" block in the response: same shape every time.

item.name: Website form · Arabic field names + Arabic digits

request.description: Arabic keys (الاسم/الجوال) and Arabic-Indic digits → mobile +9665…

item.name: Meta Lead Ads form · spaced +966 phone

exec: pm.test('source = Google Lead Form', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().normalized.source).to.eql('Google Lead Form'));

request.description: Real Google Ads webhook shape. No message → the agent greets and asks the first question.

item.name: WhatsApp Cloud API · real nested payload

request.description: entry → changes → value → messages[0]; 966… without + → +966…

item.name: CSV import row · English columns, 9-digit phone, UPPERCASE email

exec: pm.test('lead keyed by what they typed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().lead_id).to.eql('FANA-R-063633784345'));
console.log('Agent should ask for a correct number:', pm.response.json().reply);

request.description: The lead is NOT rejected: mobile = null, the typed value is kept, and the agent politely asks for a correct number.
